The '''Lonnaw system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Droma sector/Legends|Droma sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lonnaw]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' stopped in this system in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] for a routine navigational check.
